liner.body_md: This recording captures Mountain Goats performing on June 18, 2005, at the China Clipper in Olympia, Washington [1]. The setlist includes tracks such as Lion's Teeth, Dance Music, and Onions, alongside rare archival items like Dinu Lipatti's Bones and Old College Try [1]. A standout moment is the encore skit involving Uno and Cheaters, which is the only archived performance of that specific segment [1]. The audio file is a 62-minute recording taped by mycarrion, who notes that the first minute of sound is affected by microphone adjustment rumble [1]. Despite this initial technical issue, the recording is rated 3.8 out of 5 by five listeners [1]. Listener winterhunt criticized the taping as poorly planned, arguing it damaged what would otherwise be a gem of a show [3]. In contrast, cut_here defended the quality, noting that mycarrion is among the best tapers in the area and that the band would be proud of the capture [5]. Similarly, OasisDouglas described the recording as beautiful after the first 60 seconds, suggesting it is difficult to improve upon [6]. The uploader, mycarrion, expressed frustration that the file was made public without their consent, particularly in a lower bitrate format, though the current file is a FLAC [4]. This show is the 73rd in the archive's collection for the band, following a performance at KEXP Radio two days prior [7].
